name: ad_alert_practitioner
title: Alert Healthcare Practitioner
subtitle: send alert, notify clinician, trigger notification, clinical alert
description: Send a notification or alert to a healthcare professional in response to clinical events, thresholds, or workflow triggers.

expression.description: Characterizes how quickly the proposed act must be initiated. Accepted values are: routine, urgent, asap, stat.
The content to be communicated to the recipient.
The device, individual, or organization who asks for the information to be shared.
The list of entities (e.g. person, organization, clinical information system, device, group, or care team) which is the intended target of the communication.
The list of entities (e.g. person, organization, clinical information system, or device) which is to be the source of the communication.

name: ad_clinical_procedure
title: Perform Clinical Procedure
subtitle: medical procedure, surgical intervention, clinical intervention, treatment procedure
description: Execution of a clinical or surgical procedure performed by qualified healthcare personnel for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes.

expression.description: Clinical procedure type: The type of clinical procedure to be executed
Anatomic location where the procedure should be performed. This is the target site.

name: ad_collect_specimen
title: Collect Biological Specimen
subtitle: sample collection, blood draw, specimen retrieval, lab sample collection
description: Collection of a biological sample such as blood, urine, or tissue for laboratory analysis and diagnostic evaluation.

expression.description: Specimen type: The type of biological sample to be collected
Anatomic location where the speciment has to be collected. This is the target site.

name: ad_complete_questionnaire
title: Complete Clinical Questionnaire
subtitle: fill questionnaire, patient survey, PROM collection, symptom questionnaire, anamnesis form
description: Collect structured information from the patient through a questionnaire, including anamnesis, follow-up assessments, or patient-reported outcomes.

expression.description: The reference to the FHIR Resource Questionnaire that represents the questionnaire to be compiled

name: ad_diet_indication
title: Prescribe Dietary Plan
subtitle: diet prescription, nutrition plan, dietary recommendation, food regimen
description: Definition of a dietary regimen tailored to the patient's clinical condition, including restrictions, recommendations, and nutritional goals.

expression.description: Diet given orally in contrast to enteral (tube) feeding.
Oral nutritional products given in order to add further nutritional value to the patient's diet.
Feeding provided through the gastrointestinal tract via a tube, catheter, or stoma that delivers nutrition distal to the oral cavity.

name: ad_educate_patient
title: Provide Patient Education
subtitle: patient instruction, counseling, education session, training, self-care guidance
description: Provide the patient with information, documentation, or training necessary to understand and correctly perform a clinical activity such as an examination, therapy, or visit.

expression.description: Patient instruction: The information or guidance to be provided to the patient regarding the clinical activity, including details on how to perform the activity, expected outcomes, and any necessary precautions.

name: ad_perform_exercise
title: Perform exercise
subtitle: Perform an exercise, Do a physical exercise, Carry out an exercise, Execute a physical activity, Engage in physical exercise, Complete an exercise, Practice a physical exercise, Undertake a physical activity
description: An action that involves carrying out a planned physical activity or movement, typically intended to be executed according to specific instructions or goals.

expression.description: Exercise type: The type of exercise to be executed

name: ad_perform_imaging
title: Perform Diagnostic Imaging Study
subtitle: radiology exam, imaging procedure, MRI, CT scan, ultrasound, X-ray
description: Execute a diagnostic imaging procedure to visualize internal anatomical structures for diagnostic or monitoring purposes.

expression.description: Imaging modality: The type of diagnostic imaging procedure to be performed
Anatomic location where the imaging study should be performed. This is the target site.

name: ad_provide_therapy
title: Provide Therapeutic Intervention
subtitle: therapy session, treatment, rehabilitation therapy, non-pharmacological treatment
description: Delivery of a therapeutic intervention excluding medications, such as physiotherapy, psychotherapy, or other rehabilitative treatments.

expression.description: Therapy type: The type of therapeutic intervention to be provided
Anatomic location where the therapy should be performed. This is the target site.

name: ad_request_observation
title: Request Clinical Observation
subtitle: order observation, request measurement, continuous observation, diagnostic test, vital signs check or tracking
description: Request the measurement, evaluation, or recording of clinical data such as vital signs, laboratory tests, or diagnostic observations.

expression.description: The clinical observation to be acquired

name: ad_specialist_visit
title: Attend Scheduled Specialist Visit
subtitle: attend appointment, specialist consultation visit, medical visit attendance, go to appointment
description: Attend and complete a previously scheduled specialist medical visit. The appointment details are defined within or referenced by this request, and the patient is expected to attend at the specified time and location.

expression.description: The type of specialist visit to be attended or the specialist that has to perform the visit

name: ad_take_medication
title: Administer medication
subtitle: Administer a drug, Give a medication, Provide a medication, Deliver a medication, Dispense a medication, Apply a treatment, Supply a drug, Issue a medication
description: An action that involves providing or delivering a substance intended to produce a specific effect, typically following a defined instruction or schedule.

expression.description: The medication to be taken
The dose of the medication to be taken
